blocks.text: Bad Bunny has found a fan in Miss Universe Philippines Bea Millan-Windorski, who said she would love to see the Grammy award-winning Puerto Rican rapper and singer watch the 2026 Miss Universe pageant in his home territory. The American-Filipino activist, model and beauty queen revealed this at her send-off press conference held in Pasay City on Tuesday afternoon, Nov. 3, two days before she is set to fly to the United States territory in the Caribbean. “‘DeBÍ TiRAR MáS FOToS’ is an album that’s really special to me.
